ops.text: ccx vcs ship on a plain-git clone parked on a feature branch tracking origin/main pushes the BRANCH by name (not the tracked main), then watches whatever workflow appears on that commit — a skipped side workflow (cc-notes, 1s, conclusion=skipped) — and reports 'pushed <branch> → origin · CI success'. Vacuous success: ci.yml triggers only on push:main/PR, so no vet/test ran at all. Hit 2026-07-26 in /tmp/repin-wave/synckit during the helper-plist release wave (commit 063c275); caught only because the lane cross-checked gh run list --commit. Ship's push-target resolution should honor the branch's tracked upstream (or refuse), and the CI watch should refuse to call skipped-only run sets a success.
